nodes.label: Excluded Standards Sections
nodes.rationale: The original Product quality and Color sections were explicitly excluded by the user; every other recorded section is an active requirement.

nodes.label: Visual Direction Standard
nodes.rationale: Modern, minimal, calm and distinctive without decoration; generic landing-page templates, purple-on-white AI styling, glassmorphism, decorative blobs, badge spam and emoji interface icons are banned.

nodes.label: No Green Glow Rule (Standards)
nodes.rationale: Status is communicated with clear text and restrained semantic styling instead of green glowing dots or pulsing lights.

nodes.label: Layout Standard
nodes.rationale: Design intentionally for mobile, tablet and desktop rather than scaling desktop down; avoid nested card containers and keep secondary actions subordinate.

nodes.label: Typography Standard
nodes.rationale: At most two font families, a consistent scale, sentence case, and no excessive bold or very light gray body text.

nodes.label: Component Standard
nodes.rationale: Reuse existing components first, cover hover/focus/active/loading/disabled/empty/validation/error/success states, use the project icon library rather than improvised SVGs, and keep forms semantic and keyboard-accessible.

nodes.label: Motion Standard
nodes.rationale: Motion is sparing and purposeful; constant movement and ornamental motion are out, and prefers-reduced-motion must be respected.

nodes.label: Implementation Quality Standard
nodes.rationale: Use the existing framework and styling system, add no major dependencies without need, use realistic content, leave no nonfunctional controls and never hide errors with silent fallbacks.

nodes.label: UI Verification Checklist
nodes.rationale: After UI changes: format/typecheck/test, keep the app running, inspect in a browser, and check 375/768/1280/1440px for overflow, wrapping, contrast, keyboard navigation and focus visibility.
